chunks: Then look at the Black Stone, face it directly, and say:
All praise is due to Allah, who guided us to this, and we would not have been guided had Allah not guided us.

Glory be to Allah, and all praise is due to Allah. There is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He causes death and gives life, and He is the Ever-Living who does not die. In His hand is all goodness, and He is powerful over all things. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with the best of what You have blessed and bestowed mercy upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. Peace be upon all the Prophets and the Messengers, and all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I believe in Your promise, affirm Your messengers, and follow Your Book.

key_terms.بِوَعْدِكَ: Your promise; referring to trust and belief in Allah’s true promise
key_terms.رُسُلَكَ: Your messengers; the prophets sent by Allah
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ: glory be to Allah; declaring Allah free from all imperfection
key_terms.كِتَابَكَ: Your Book; the divine revelation that is to be followed
key_terms.لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ: there is no deity but Allah; the core declaration of tawhid
key_terms.ٱللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ م: a supplication asking Allah to send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
key_terms.ٱلْحَجَرِ ٱلْأَسْوَدِ: the Black Stone at the Ka'bah, faced during this hajj supplication
key_terms.ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: praise belongs to Allah; an expression of gratitude and devotion

ai.seo_question: What should be recited when facing the Black Stone during hajj?
ai.summary: This passage teaches a supplication to be recited while facing the Black Stone during the rites of hajj. It combines gratitude for divine guidance, declarations of tawhid, blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and an affirmation of faith in Allah’s promise, messengers, and Book.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Then, look at the Black Stone and face it directly, and say:
"All praise is due to Allah (swt), who guided us to this, and we would not have been guided had Allah (swt) not guided us.

Glory be to Allah (swt), and all praise is due to Allah (swt). There is no deity except Allah (swt), and Allah (swt) is the Greatest. There is no deity except Allah (swt) alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He causes death and gives life, and He is the Ever-Living who does not die. In His hand is all goodness, and He is capable of all things.
O Allah (swt), send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have sent blessings and blessings and mercy upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Peace be upon all the Prophets and Messengers, and all praise is due to Allah (swt), the Lord (azj) of all the worlds.
O Allah (swt), I believe in Your promise, I affirm Your messengers, and I follow Your Book."
